title: Compramos Meme
description: This adds the compramos carros y camionetas wandering trader meme jumpscare to the game
body:
### Hello minecraft mod users!
On this mod, i introduce to you the Compramos Carros y Camionetas Meme as a jumpscare in minecraft!

### How it works.
This mod checks if you are in a cave by seeing the light level around you, if it is less than 7 then it has a random chance of him appearing. When you wake up from your confortable bed, you also trigger him into scaring you. Stay aware on your dreams!

### Commands
There is also a command called

```
/forcetroll <Player>
```
This command makes you force spawn the wandering trader to troll someone with the loud compramos sound when you look at them.

**Inspirations [Here](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/CtqFgnms1Kc)**


_**Have fun trolling your friends!**_
